remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home, perfect for modern living and versatile needs. This move-in ready property boasts a new roof and newer kitchen and bathrooms. The main level features a spacious living area open to the kitchen, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Also on this level is a bedroom, a full bath and a "flex" room that is currently being used as an office but could also function as an additional bedroom, dining room or den. Two additional spacious bedrooms are located on the 2nd floor, including the ensuite primary bedroom. The lower level offers endless potential with ample space for an in-law apartment or additional living quarters, complete with the separate entry. There is an enclosed porch off the kitchen and the private backyard with terrace provides space for outdoor enjoyment. Located in a desirable neighborhood, just minutes to the train, beach, I95, Merritt Parkway, SoNo Collection, Stew Leonard's and more, this home combines modern amenities with flexibility, making it a special find.
